info.title: EhViewer Switch
info.author: Schweik7
info.details:
EhViewer for Nintendo Switch is a homebrew client for E-Hentai and ExHentai, ported from the Android app EhViewer (C++17, libnx, SDL2). WARNING: the sites it browses host adult content.

- Browse the front page, watched, popular, toplists and favorites (all 10 folders); search and save searches as subscriptions.
- Gallery details: tags, comments, rating and favorites; tap a tag or the uploader to search.
- Background downloads with resume, per-task pause and resume, and a live speed display. Read while downloading.
- Reader in portrait (console held sideways), landscape or double-page mode, with saved progress.
- Touch support and a Chinese/English UI.

Setup: put your site cookies (ipb_member_id, ipb_pass_hash, and igneous for ExHentai) in sdmc:/config/EhViewerSwitch/cookies.ini, and a cacert.pem next to it (included in the release zip).

changelog: 0.5.2: first public release. Per-task download pause/resume, favorites folders, quick menu switching cancels stale requests, new icon.
